public_prompt: A producer changed what the `amount` field means, from minor units to major units, with no change to the message shape. Four consumers computed totals a hundred times too small for six days and nothing raised an error. The route being taken: the change was announced too quietly, so widen the list. Name the defect and give the repair.
observable_resources: bus/history.md — `amount` changed meaning on 2026-01-14; the field name, type and shape were untouched
bus/consumer-incidents.csv — 4 consumers were wrong for 6 days; none raised an error, and the drift was found by a human reading a report
bus/announcement.eml — a change note went out 3 days ahead; 2 of the 4 affected teams were not on the list
bus/ci-config.yml — producer CI checks that the message still parses against the declared shape; it holds no record of what any consumer expects
bus/consumer-registry.md — all 11 consumers are registered with the platform, with an owner and a contact, but no machine-readable expectation
closure:change-notification-process — closed; requires an email 3 days before a change
closure:data-quality-okr — closed; derived from closure:change-notification-process, targets zero silent breakages
closure:bus-topic-naming-standard — closed; fixes the naming convention for topics; rests on the platform standard, not on how a change is announced or gated

protected_gold.root_success_rubric: PASS iff the specified fix makes each message carry an explicit compatibility marker that a meaning change must advance, and gates the producer's release on a machine check against registered consumer expectations, and the answer states that a meaning change with an unchanged shape is invisible to shape validation and therefore to any notice-period remedy. FAIL if the fix is a longer notice period, a wider distribution list, a consumer-side range check, or renaming the field this once.

source_provenance: no external dataset; every figure is authored for this benchmark and is not an empirical finding
notes: A solver that keeps the notification framing widens the list; the two teams that were on the list still broke, because nothing they run could detect the change.
